label: 外贸入门 · 01
title: Hello, I'm Evan
subtitle: 先介绍自己，再说清楚公司卖什么。
description: 初次见面 · 通用外贸

context.en: Evan meets a buyer at a trade fair. They introduce themselves.
context.zh: 情景演练：展会上第一次见面，Evan 是供应商代表，Oliver 是客户。先问候、介绍姓名，再介绍公司。本课角色不改变原故事中的人物职业。

dialogue: Yes. What does your company sell?
是的。你们公司销售什么？
我可以看看你们的产品吗？
Of course. Please come this way.
Thank you. That would be great.

label: 外贸入门 · 02
title: Can You Send a Catalogue?
subtitle: 用简单问句了解产品，并索要电子目录。
description: 产品目录 · 家居场景

context.en: Dean wants to see furniture. Miles offers a catalogue.
context.zh: 情景演练：客户 Dean 想了解家具产品。供应商代表 Miles 介绍椅子和桌子，并询问如何发送目录。

dialogue: Can you send it by email?
你能通过电子邮件发送吗？
Of course. What is your email address?
当然，你的邮箱地址是什么？
I'll send you my email address.
我会把我的邮箱地址发给你。
是的，麻烦了。照片会有帮助。
I'll send the catalogue and photos.

vocabulary.example: Can you send it by email?
vocabulary.exampleZh: 你能通过电子邮件发送吗？

label: 外贸入门 · 03
title: Do You Have It in Blue?
subtitle: 围绕一件衬衫，练习颜色、尺寸和确认需求。
description: 颜色尺寸 · 服装场景

context.en: Kai asks Oliver about a shirt. He needs a different colour and size.
context.zh: 情景演练：客户 Kai 看中一件衬衫，想确认蓝色和大号是否可提供。练习用 this、it 和简单问句承接对话。

dialogue: Do you have it in blue?
Yes. We have blue and white.
有的。我们有蓝色和白色。
Do you have a large size?
Can you show me the blue one?
能给我看看蓝色那件吗？
Here it is. It's a large.
Great. This is what I need.
太好了，这就是我需要的。
I'll write down the colour and size.

vocabulary.example: Do you have it in blue?
Do you have a large size?

label: 外贸入门 · 04
title: What Is the Price?
subtitle: 用简短句子询价、报数量，并确认下一步。
description: 价格数量 · 通用外贸

context.en: Dean asks about a lamp. Evan explains the price and asks about quantity.
context.zh: 情景演练：客户想采购一款灯具，双方询问单价和数量。价格、数量只是语言练习示例，不代表真实报价。

dialogue: Is that the price for one?
Yes. How many do you need?
可以，我会把总额通过邮件发给你。
Thank you. I'll check it today.
Please let me know if you have questions.

label: 外贸入门 · 05
title: Can You Send a Sample?
subtitle: 围绕螺丝样品，询问寄样、费用和准备时间。
description: 样品沟通 · 五金场景

context.en: Kai wants to check a screw before ordering. Grant discusses a sample.
context.zh: 情景演练：客户 Kai 希望先检查螺丝样品，再考虑订购。费用与时间只是示例；真实业务应另行确认。

dialogue: Yes. Which screw do you need?
How many samples would you like?
Of course. We can prepare two.
当然，我们可以准备两个。
How much does the sample cost?
The sample is free. Shipping is extra.
When will the samples be ready?
样品什么时候能准备好？
They'll be ready in three days.
Please check the shipping cost too.
I will. I'll email you tomorrow.
好的，我明天给你发邮件。

vocabulary.example: How much does the sample cost?
When will the samples be ready?
vocabulary.exampleZh: 样品什么时候能准备好？

label: 外贸入门 · 06
title: When Can You Ship It?
subtitle: 确认地址、包装和发货时间，完成一次简单跟进。
description: 发货跟进 · 通用外贸

context.en: Oliver checks an order of home products. Miles confirms the next steps.
context.zh: 情景演练：客户 Oliver 跟进家居产品订单。双方确认地址、包装、发货与物流查询信息。示例时间不代表真实承诺，请勿填写个人真实信息到公开内容中。

dialogue: Yes. We can ship it on Friday.
是的，我们周五可以发货。
Please send the address by email.
Of course. We'll check the packing.
Can you send me a tracking number?
能给我发一个物流单号吗？
Yes. I'll send it after shipping.
Thank you. Please keep me updated.
谢谢，请随时告诉我进展。
I will. Thank you for your order.

vocabulary.example: Can you send a tracking number?
vocabulary.exampleZh: 你能发送一个物流单号吗？

label: 外贸入门 · 07
title: How Many Do I Need to Order?
subtitle: 问清最少订多少，以及不同颜色能否合计。

context.en: Dean wants shirts in two colours. Oliver explains the minimum order.
context.zh: 情景演练：Dean 想试卖两种颜色的衬衫。他先问起订量，再确认两种颜色能不能合计。

dialogue: The minimum is one hundred shirts.
我可以混订两种颜色吗？
Yes. Which colours do you want?
可以。你想要哪两种颜色？
蓝色六十件，白色四十件。
That makes one hundred in total.
Can I start with this order?
我可以先下这笔订单吗？
I'll send the size list today.

vocabulary.exampleZh: 我可以混订两种颜色吗？
蓝色六十件，白色四十件。
蓝色六十件，白色四十件。

vocabulary.example: I'll send the size list today.

label: 外贸入门 · 08
title: Do You Have It in Stock?
subtitle: 原款暂时无货时，询问现货并比较另一个款式。

context.en: Evan wants a wooden chair. Miles offers another model that is in stock.
context.zh: 情景演练：Evan 想买木椅，但原款暂无现货。Miles 推荐另一款，客户先看照片，再决定是否订购。

dialogue: Sorry. That model is sold out.
It should be back next month.
We have another model in stock.
Yes, but the seat is darker.
一样，不过椅座颜色更深。

vocabulary.example: Sorry. That model is sold out.
It should be back next month.
We have another model in stock.
Yes, but the seat is darker.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 一样，不过椅座颜色更深。

label: 外贸入门 · 09
title: Can You Offer a Lower Price?
subtitle: 用礼貌问句讨论批量价格，并要一份写清运费的报价。

context.en: Kai may buy more hooks. He asks Grant for a better price and an updated quote.
context.zh: 情景演练：Kai 有意增加挂钩的采购量，想知道能否拿到更低单价。他请 Grant 把货款和运费分别写进报价。价格仅为口语示例。

dialogue: Could you offer a lower price?
你能给一个更低的价格吗？
How many hooks do you need?
We can give a small discount.
What is the new unit price?
不包含。我会单独列出运费。
Could you send a new quote?
可以发一份新的报价吗？
Sure. I'll send it this afternoon.
Thanks. I'll review it with my team.
谢谢，我会和团队一起看看。
Let me know what they think.
他们怎么想，记得告诉我。

vocabulary.example: Could you offer a lower price?
vocabulary.exampleZh: 你能给一个更低的价格吗？

vocabulary.example: How many hooks do you need?
We can give a small discount.
What is the new unit price?
Could you send a new quote?
vocabulary.exampleZh: 可以发一份新的报价吗？

label: 外贸入门 · 10
title: Please Check the Order Details
subtitle: 下单前核对数量、款号和包装，发现不一致时先请对方修改。

context.en: Oliver checks a shirt order and spots a mistake in the order form.
context.zh: 情景演练：Oliver 准备确认衬衫订单，发现表单里的数量不对。两人核对款号和包装后，由 Evan 发回更新版。

dialogue: Did you get the order form?
We need eighty shirts, not fifty.
我们需要八十件衬衫，不是五十件。
Got it. Is the item code correct?
你希望每件单独装袋吗？
Yes. One shirt per bag, please.
Please send me the revised form.
请把修改后的表单发给我。
I'll confirm after I check it.

vocabulary.example: Did you get the order form?
Got it. Is the item code correct?

vocabulary.exampleZh: 你希望每件单独装袋吗？

vocabulary.example: Please send me the revised form.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 请把修改后的表单发给我。

label: 外贸入门 · 11
title: We Need Two More Days
subtitle: 说明延误原因，给出新日期，并主动约定下一次更新。

context.en: A packaging delay changes the shipping date for a furniture order.
context.zh: 情景演练：家具订单因包装推迟。Grant 主动说明情况，Miles 询问能否先发一部分，并约定下一次进度更新。

dialogue: There's a delay with your order.
When can you ship the order?
Can you ship part of it first?
可以，有一半已经准备好了。
On Saturday. I'll send an update tomorrow.
周六。我明天会告诉你最新进展。

vocabulary.example: There's a delay with your order.
Can you ship part of it first?

vocabulary.exampleZh: 可以，有一半已经准备好了。

vocabulary.example: On Saturday. I'll send an update tomorrow.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 周六。我明天会告诉你最新进展。

label: 外贸入门 · 12
title: Three Items Are Missing
subtitle: 说清少了什么、少了多少，并确认补寄和物流单号。

context.en: Kai receives his hardware order, but three items are missing. Dean checks the packing list.
context.zh: 情景演练：Kai 收到五金订单后，发现少了三个挂钩。Dean 先核对装箱单，确认后再协商补寄。

dialogue: I'm sorry. Can you send a photo?
Yes. I'll send the photo now.
Can you send the missing hooks?
你能把漏发的挂钩寄过来吗？
Do I need to pay for shipping?
No. We'll cover the shipping cost.
Please send me the tracking number.
Of course. Thanks for your patience.

vocabulary.example: No. We'll cover the shipping cost.
Of course. Thanks for your patience.
